extracted.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
extracted.description: This chocolate peanut butter pie has a rich, creamy peanut butter filling topped with chocolate pudding and whipped topping for an easy no-bake dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Combine butter and peanut butter in a medium, microwave-safe bowl. Heat in the microwave until soft; mix well.
Gradually stir in confectioners’ sugar until mixture resembles a soft dough.
Spread mixture into two prepared pie crusts.
Mix milk with instant pudding in a small bowl; pour over peanut butter mixture in each crust. Chill until firm.
Top pies with whipped topping when ready to serve.
